narr: Heavy rainfall from thunderstorms resulted in widespread street flooding in Madison County.
ev: FM 2289 from TX-OSR to FM 978 was closed due to flooding. A social media picture showed water covering the roadway.
Several county roadways were closed across parts of Northern Madison County due to floodwaters.
